name: menu_association
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: raster UI surface for a bright Seoul office hunter mobile game. Generate ONE isolated, front-facing long horizontal frosted acrylic parallelogram menu plate on REAL transparent background. No text, numbers, icons, logos or watermark.
Composition: a narrow broad plate, aspect about 5.25:1, top edge shifted to the RIGHT of lower edge by about 5.5 percent of body width; perfectly straight horizontal top/bottom, vertical height small, top-left corner inset, bottom-left corner farther left. NO perspective tilt, NOT a trapezoid. Generous transparent space outside. Center empty for game text/icon.
Material: pale cool white, blue-washed smoked/frosted glass, finely rendered satin depth, subtle very fine grain, soft broad top reflection, restrained prismatic light along cut edge. Bright tasteful consumer-product operating UI, mature, crisp at mobile scale. Same feel as a clean operations panel over a warm bright blurred office. Quiet blue(#2f7bf5) slender acrylic inlay along far LEFT slanted side, no other accent hue. Left inlay about 2 percent width. Pale interior visually translucent, reflectivity delicate, no giant hotspots/no diagonal stripe decoration crossing middle.
The edge should feel like light refracting through polished glass with thin darker underside, not an ink outline. Very slight layered clear lip on upper-right only, restrained short corner facet highlights. No thick metal border, no brackets floating in blank margin, no screws, no sci-fi frame, no ornamental circuit lines, no chrome machine, no text or holographic writing. Empty body with understated finely textured light material, NOT flat vector shapes. Render as clean hand-finished high-end 2.5D game raster surface. Want final display body252x48 with2x master, so fine texture but clear overall silhouette. Alpha outside object exactly zero; no background color or checkerboard baked in.
